_comment: Items the WoWSims database lists as released (it marks every item phase 1) but that cannot be had in WoW Forever yet. Kept by hand; checked 2026-11-22. `tags`: every item with this line under its name. `iconWords`: every item whose icon name holds this word. `zones`: every drop in these zones. `npcs`: every drop of these creatures. `items`: single items, with the reason. `reputations`: factions that cannot be gained yet; their rewards stay out of every plan until the line is taken out here.

tags.Crafted: A crafted class set (Spiritcaller, Grovekeeper, Glory, Demonheart, Grimstitch, Manaflare, Conviction): its patterns come from raids
